name: Press
source:
The button grants a single wish... or erases all of existence.

With 1 in 63 odds, do you press the button?

Why? Why not? It'll just wind up in someone else's hands eventually...

A short VN about a button/a curse/a wish/a choice.

[From [url=https://cuttlefishofdoom.itch.io/press]Itch.io[/url]]
